channel.title: The Valley Desk
channel.description: Local health-tech news for people and agents

item.title: Penn Medicine expands ambient scribe pilots across ambulatory
item.description: Penn ambient-scribe expansion is an ambulatory labor story, not a vendor launch.

item.title: New Jersey flags hospital cyber readiness ahead of fall season
item.description: NJ's hospital cyber advisory lands on fall staffing and downtime drills across the river.

item.title: Jefferson Einstein records move to MyJeffersonHealth on Sept. 26
item.description: Einstein's Sept. 26 MyChart cutover is a Jefferson operations clock, not a chapter event.

item.title: ChristianaCare Epic go-live, official July 2026 update
item.description: Oct. 3 is a training-gated cutover on ChristianaCare’s own update; Becker’s second-cites that date and does not price Epic.

item.title: Jefferson FY2026 operating loss and Fitch liquidity
item.description: The $181.5 million year-end operating loss sits next to $5.5 billion / 119 DCOH through March 31; Harrington says the climb holds only if commercial contracts do.

item.title: Penn in-house scribe headcount and 2024 JAMA pilot table
item.description: Some 1,200 is an Inquirer headcount for Penn’s later in-house tool; 20.4% less time in notes is a 46-clinician journal table from a 2024 DAX Copilot pilot, not that headcount.

item.title: Temple Dragon Copilot user count and TUHS cash days
item.description: Dragon Copilot is at 400 end users in the HealthTech clip; 116 DCOH is an unaudited TUHS year-end line, not a Copilot KPI.

item.title: CHOP ORCA repo for Epic downtime order sets
item.description: ORCA is an offline read-only Epic order-set viewer for downtime; it does not hold patient data and cannot place orders.

item.title: Tower Health CIO on AI label, AI tax, and owned platforms
item.description: Tower will not pay an AI premium without a proof-of-value under its own conditions, and it is pressing vendors for value from platforms it already owns.

item.title: A Delaware Valley CIO on why ambient AI is a workforce story
item.description: Local executive post, ingested later via LinkedIn/X.

item.title: PA DOH updates telehealth documentation guidance
item.description: PA telehealth documentation guidance changes what clerks and CMIO shops have to capture on Sept 1.
